content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is not a workaround. It’s a base-layer infrastructure stack designed for creators who sell digital products like music, beats, or plugins. It combines free and paid tools into a fully operational online store. The core components include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. The result? A platform-independent store that you own, control, and deploy anywhere in the world.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it works: Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally accessible. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates order processing and file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring data ownership. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges just 0.5% per transaction. Once payment is confirmed on-chain, the system automatically delivers your music files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. No middlemen. No platform fees. Just direct sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unreliable. If you’re selling music, beats, or plugins and can’t use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want to retain more of their earnings. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching from Gumroad’s 10% fee to NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee retains $921 more in your pocket. This isn’t just a tool—it’s a shift toward infrastructure sovereignty.
Retain 99.5% of every sale with NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee—compared to Gumroad’s 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is modular but integrated. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend tasks like order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required. File delivery is handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring instant access for buyers. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Ready to deploy? Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH. These pre-built stacks include everything you need to launch in 48 hours. Alternatively, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re selling music, beats, or plugins, this infrastructure gives you the tools to operate globally, accept crypto, and own your entire stack.

This setup ensures you retain full control over your store and avoid platform fees. If you’re looking to sell notion templates, fonts, or software using USDT or Bitcoin, the principles outlined here apply. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, giving you everything needed to build and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, it’s the fastest way to deploy a platform-independent store that accepts crypto and delivers digital products automatically.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, global accessibility. 2. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing and file delivery. 3. Configure order storage: Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store customer data securely. 4. Integrate payment processing: Use NOWPayments to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. 5. Set up file delivery: Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver music files instantly. 6. Test end-to-end: Ensure payments trigger automatic file delivery. 7. Deploy: Launch your store and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are pre-built and deployed for you within 48 hours. No coding required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, and Solana. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. This stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Sheets. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% per transaction.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products?
Yes. The stack is designed for ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. Simply add products to your store.
What happens after deployment?
You own and control everything. COREMERCH has no access to your stack after delivery. It’s your infrastructure to operate and scale as needed.
